notes: E10 showed that runs of spaces collapse in the output: the box splits on whitespace (dropping empty pieces) rather than on single spaces, so `"a  Ib  c"` becomes `"a bI c"` not `"a  bI  c"`. Changing `split(' ')` to `split()` fixes all of E10 while leaving E1–E9 unchanged (they had no internal double spaces), and is shorter.
